description: Located in beautiful Rincon, Puerto Rico this spacious 1st floor condo has 3 bedrooms, 2 baths and is the perfect size for your family vacation. It is walking distance to the beach, bakery, supermarket, and downtown plaza. Freshly painted and tastefully furnished, this corner unit boasts a wrap around terrace with views of the pool. A short stroll along the canal brings you to the ocean with a sizable beach perfect for water sports and stunning sunsets.The spaceThe master bedroom has a his and her closet and private bathroom with a stand up shower. The guest bathroom has been newly updated. The second bedroom has a queen bed with shelving and room to hang your clothes, while the 3rd bedroom has a long closet the size of one wall. This condo has an AC unit located in every room. WIFI, TV and stackable washer and dryer are also available. Please note that the TV is WIFI only and you will need your streaming information to access. The kitchen features full sized appliances. The condo has a generator and water cistern. Outdoor showers are located behind the clubhouse. Please use them and not the pool to clean off sand from the beach.Guest accessThe guests will have access to all parts of the condo. There are 2 designated parking spots where you can park back to back. We ask that you do not utilize the closet straight across from the front door, in the hallway, as we use that to store supplies for cleaning and turning the condo over to new guests. The walk-in closet located in the 2nd bedroom is an owner’s closet as well and will be locked.Other things to noteDuring an emergency there may be times that power and water may be off at off-peak times in order to maintain the machines and to conserve fuel. This would only occur if the generator needs to be on for more than 3 days. Towels and clothing are not allowed to be hung on the railings, as they peel the paint, as per our HOA rules.

title: Surf Bungalow
description: Custom designed surf bungalow offering a unique vacation experience in the heart of Rincon, Puerto Rico. The bungalow is located within La Casa del Surfer on private property directly accessed from the 413. Less than 2 km to Maria's, Domes & Tres Palmas (surf breaks) and Steps Beach Marine Reserve for snorkeling. Walk to beaches, downtown plaza, restaurants & bars.The spacePLEASE READ FIRST ! This bungalow is offering a relaxing "glamping" experience. Expect your surroundings to include luscious greenery, fruit trees and ocean breezes. The bungalow is open air (no AC), includes one queen bed with fresh linens and towels, a small fridge and coffee maker . There is a private outdoor bathroom and shower (please note there is no hot water). After a day in the sun, La Casa del Surfer is a peaceful place to relax while listening to the waves break on the shore and the coqui chirp in the creek. Get insider tips from your host, learn to surf, indulge in the culture, listen to live music, disconnect and enjoy the experience!

title: Surfer Villa with Pool Short Walk to Beach
description: Bienvenidos a Casa Naniki, where simplicity embraces elegance and comfort! Ideal for family and friends seeking Rincon's treasures. In the heart of Rincon, steps away from the beach, restaurants, bars, supermarket, food trucks, downtown and more! Perfect for entertaining!Naniki is a spirit representing activity according to Caribbean Taino heritage. Casa Naniki is where the fun begins!The spaceStep into paradise at our property, surrounded by lush tropical grounds adorned with fruitful trees. The outdoor area offers a kitchen island, a refreshing swimming pool and an array of lounging options – from recliners to hammocks. An outdoor shower and bathroom add to the convenience. You can also find an array of recreational items including pool towels, boogie board, and beach chairs.On the first floor, discover a master suite featuring a king-size bed, AC, a full bathroom, a cozy couch, and a functional desk. Adjacent to this retreat is a spacious room, adorned with two full-size bunk beds (four full-size beds in total), AC, dressers and access to the master bedroom's bathroom. The room is also equipped with a laundry area. The garage is designated for storage purposes only and is not available for guest access.Ascend to the second floor, where a newly renovated kitchen and living room await. The balcony, complete with a lounge area, and inviting hammocks, is the perfect spot for breakfasts with a view and evening sunsets.The five-star kitchen, with its island and dining table, is stocked with essential amenities, ensuring you feel at home in this tropical retreat. The comfortable living room features a Roku TV, board games, local area information, and reliable Wifi. The first bedroom, a queen-size master suite, boasts a full-size bathroom, AC, built-ins, a full-size mirror, and convenient accessories. The second bedroom features a queen-size bed, AC, a full-size mirror, and a full-size bathroom just across the hall. The third room offers twin beds, AC, built-in storage, and a night table with a light. Each space is meticulously designed for comfort and style, making your stay a true tropical getaway.Guest accessThis property is located off 115, right in the heart of Rincon!
